items.title: Former DUP leader Donaldson sentenced to 15 years in prison for child sex abuse
items.summary: Jeffrey Donaldson was convicted of 18 counts of sex abuse, including one of rape, which he committed against two women when they were children.

items.title: Trump calls off livestream for Fort Hood shooter's execution by firing squad
items.summary: The planned execution of Nidal Hasan is scheduled to be the first military execution in more than 60 years.

items.title: Severe drought declared in parts of southern England
items.summary: Reservoir levels continue to drop after a hot summer and less September rain than normal.

items.title: Russell Brand accuser says alleged rape left her afraid she may be pregnant
items.summary: The 51-year-old faces three counts of rape, three charges of sexual assault and one of indecent assault.

items.title: Infantino apologises to Fifa Council - but told he's still not fit to lead
items.summary: President Gianni Infantino apologises to the Fifa Council for his World Cup sell-off plan - but is asked to go further.

items.title: Man killed by tiger climbed two fences before suffering multiple injuries, inquest hears
items.summary: William Chapman climbed two fences to enter a tiger's pen at Yorkshire Wildlife Park, an inquest hears.

items.title: Watch: Swimmer's emotional TV plea for cancer research leads to meeting with PM
items.summary: Scottish athlete, Archie Goodburn, who was diagnosed with three inoperable brain tumours two years ago, met Andy Burnham after an appeal for more investment into brain cancer research.

items.title: Russia accuses Ukraine of attacking oil refinery after Zelensky says strikes to resume
items.summary: Ukraine's president says a pause on striking energy sites is over following fresh Russian attacks.
